review_provenance: Sequential role-separated producer, critic and evaluator passes; not independent review.

findings.description: The UI and Python runtime had no shared authoritative control plane.
findings.evidence: Default API-backed UI, 44 backend tests, 47 frontend tests, live HTTP persistence smoke and green CI.

findings.description: Run and approval state was process-local and not tenant, hash, policy or idempotency bound.
findings.evidence: Tenancy, replay, concurrency, manifest-TOCTOU and restart-persistence probes passed.
Runtime lock pins setuptools 83.0.0; exact hash audit reports no known vulnerabilities.

findings.description: An app attached only to an internal Compose network did not publish its declared loopback port.
findings.evidence: Separated edge and internal networks; localhost smoke and CI Compose gate pass.

findings.description: A broad Cloud Run admin role and missing explicit image-read boundary exceeded runtime deployment needs.
findings.evidence: Exact 19-permission custom Cloud Run role, no roles/run.admin, repository-scoped Artifact Registry reader, preflight and post-apply evidence tests.

findings.description: The plan identity could mutate durable Terraform state through an object-admin grant.
findings.evidence: Foundation and runtime states are split; plan can read state and manage only disposable runtime lock objects; apply is runtime-prefix scoped.

findings.description: Foreign keys did not force dependent records to share their parent's tenant.
findings.evidence: Migration 0002 adds composite tenant foreign keys and a PostgreSQL cross-tenant negative test.

findings.description: Arbitrary notification channel identifiers could select disabled or unverified destinations.
findings.evidence: Channels are selected by exact display name, must be enabled, and email delivery must be VERIFIED.

findings.description: Attestation verification could omit the actual checked-out HEAD and complete tracked-tree binding.
findings.evidence: Workflow verifies commit, full tracked tree, saved plan and immutable image before cloud authentication.

findings.description: Alembic configuration could disable existing application loggers.
findings.evidence: Migration logging preserves existing loggers and the platform test suite passes.

findings.description: Application, OpenAPI and test engines could survive past their owning lifecycle.
findings.evidence: Application lifespan, canonical OpenAPI and engine fixtures dispose resources; strict ResourceWarning gates pass.

findings.description: The compatibility client path emitted deprecation warnings and obscured the supported runtime floor.
findings.evidence: Project requires Python 3.10+, uses httpx2, and strict deprecation warnings pass on Python 3.13.5.

findings.description: A job-wide PostgreSQL URL contaminated hermetic SQLite migration tests.
findings.evidence: PostgreSQL URL is step-scoped; migration tests delete inherited configuration; contamination probe and CI pass.

findings.description: setInterval could overlap a terminal refresh and issue an extra GET.
findings.evidence: Sequential recursive timeout cancels and stops on terminal response; eight focused repetitions and CI pass.
Python minimum is 3.10; exact lock resolves pytest 9.1.1; current local and CI audits pass.

findings.description: Historical trailing whitespace failed the complete-tree CI gate.
findings.evidence: Tracked text files were mechanically normalized; the exact empty-tree diff gate and CI pass.

findings.description: The required in-app browser runtime exposed no browser instances.
findings.required_fix: Repeat interactive desktop and narrow-viewport QA when an in-app browser instance is available.

findings.description: Collaboration credits were exhausted, so the final critic and evaluator passes were sequential roles performed by the primary agent.
findings.required_fix: Obtain review from a different human or independent agent before merge and before any exact cloud-plan approval.

findings.description: Zero visible open billing accounts and no authorized target project or region prevent a real saved plan or apply.
findings.required_fix: Satisfy the exact resume conditions in agent/reports/gcp-discovery-2026-07-18.md.
